title: Enum Array Zarr Convention (v1)
description: Schema for the attributes of a Zarr group conforming to the enum convention (uuid c906c423-56ed-413c-9943-7b2ff52d18f2). Describes a dictionary-encoded array: integer codes that index into a values array.

zarr_conventions.description: Per the Zarr Conventions spec; MUST contain a Convention Metadata Object identifying this convention.

enum:ordered.description: Whether the values carry a meaningful order. When true, values[0] < values[1] < ... When false, the values are unordered (the code-to-value mapping still holds, but conveys no ordering).

enum:codes.description: List of keys at which codes array live in this hierarchy as immediate children.
